headline: Reserve Bank of India Yields 6.63% Cut-Off on 364-Day T-Bills
summary: The Reserve Bank of India reported T-bill auction cut-off implicit yields of 5.8602% for 91-day, 6.5300% for 182-day, and 6.6300% for 364-day paper.
why: The Reserve Bank of India is India's central bank and monetary authority. Treasury bill yields establish benchmark short-term rupee borrowing rates.

impacts.name: Indian Government T-Bill Yields
impacts.why: Auction cut-off prices set short-term sovereign borrowing yields in the domestic money market.
